title: Artificial General Intelligence
description: A mind that can learn anything.

puzzle.goal: An artificial neuron weighs each input x_j by a learned weight w_j, adds a bias b and squashes the total into a firing probability between 0 and 1 with a smooth S-shaped curve. Write its output.
puzzle.name: Logistic (sigmoid) neuron
puzzle.form: 1 / ( 1 + exp ( - ( sumk ( j , w _ j * x _ j ) + b ) ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the output of a two-input neuron with the weights, inputs and bias below.
puzzle.method: Form the weighted sum z = Σ w_j x_j + b, then apply the function 1/(1 + e^(−z)), whose output tends to 0 and 1 at the extremes.
